reusePrinciple: Reuse the Fleet Designer grid interaction and state pattern while replacing ship-specific slot and module semantics with Island surface-cell and brush semantics. Do not import React into HB-TTRPG-tools and do not create a second persistence or lifecycle system.

conceptMapping.target: Island map columns rows and active outline
conceptMapping.rule: The rectangular grid is the editable coordinate envelope; inactive coordinates represent open air outside the Island outline.
The coordinate remains addressable but is excluded from activeCellIds and surface calculations.
Each active cell has a stable ID coordinates area terrain elevation slope usable percentage and arable percentage.
Terrain site resource water or hazard brushes are restricted by cell state slope terrain and precise envelope locks.

conceptMapping.target: cell patch or stable reference link
conceptMapping.rule: A brush changes terrain or links an existing stable entity ID without replacing the cell stable ID. Separate ledgers such as landing zones remain explicit records rather than fake cell fields.
Selecting a cell opens the exact-value Island cell inspector and preserves keyboard focus.
Left click Enter or Space applies the selected brush only when compatibility and field-lock rules pass.
Right click Delete or Backspace erases the surface content while preserving the stable cell ID unless the user explicitly creates a new cell identity.

conceptMapping.target: seed Island outline or populate selected blank cells
conceptMapping.rule: Autofill may initialize compatible blank cells but must not overwrite locked or manually edited cells.

conceptMapping.target: confirmed resize reset selected region or create new map
conceptMapping.rule: Destructive resize or reset requires a preview, explicit confirmation, and a retained recovery report. It must not silently replace the entire active Island record.
Derived diagnostics cover invalid references duplicate IDs active-cell area composition usable versus arable area and downstream capacity mismatches.

preparedLayers.responsibility: Coordinate records stable IDs editing erasure movement resizing events diagnostics and P1 map export.
Accessible pointer and keyboard interaction selection focus compatibility display safe text rendering and repainting.
Outline terrain elevation slope water site resource and hazard brushes with explicit compatibility reasons.
Grouped brush-family controls and selected-brush state without changing the Island profile.
Exact numeric and reference editing field-lock presentation and cell-specific diagnostics.

Pure resize planning removed-cell analysis direct and dependent ledger reference reporting stale-plan detection explicit confirmation and recovery snapshot presentation without dirtying preview state.
Bind the reusable grid stack to the shared editor lifecycle locks profile map diagnostics recovery autosave resize confirmation and adapter callbacks.

requiredInteractions: left click applies the selected compatible brush
right click erases or deactivates the selected cell
Enter or Space applies the selected brush
Delete or Backspace erases the selected cell
cell selection updates an external inspector
exact inspector changes preserve stable identity
resize preview does not mutate or dirty the profile
destructive resize reports removed cells outgoing links direct references and dependent references
destructive resize requires an explicit in-panel confirmation rather than browser confirm
stale resize plans are rejected after coordinate identity changes
confirmed grid resize preserves in-bounds cells and stores a transient recovery snapshot
resize cancellation leaves dimensions records dirty state and recovery state unchanged
model changes emit events and repaint the view
one model mutation produces one shared lifecycle dirty mark
field locks block only affected brush families and inspector controls
profile export omits internal view-only active selected-cell selected-brush resize-preview and resize-recovery state
activationRule: Load the complete surface-grid and resize stack through the Floating Island adapter only after P0 promotion and P1 activation. Until then the files remain inert preparation artifacts and are not added to index.html or the blocking P0 workflow.
